implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: SIZE = 15 and board = [[EMPTY] * size for _ in range(size)]

implemented_requirements.requirement: Two players (Black and White) alternate turns
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: NAMES and STONES dicts; current player stored in self.current; switch_player() toggles between 1 and 2; main loop calls game.switch_player() after each successful move

implemented_requirements.requirement: Players place stones on empty cells
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: place() checks bounds and occupancy, then writes STONES[self.current] to board

implemented_requirements.requirement: Win detection for five in a row horizontally, vertically, and both diagonals
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: DIRECTIONS includes (0,1), (1,0), (1,1), (1,-1); check_winner() iterates cells and calls _has_five() which verifies five consecutive stones in each direction

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect draw when board is full
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: is_full() returns True when no EMPTY cells remain; main loop checks it after each move

implemented_requirements.requirement: Terminal UI to display board and accept moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.py: TerminalUI.draw() prints the board; get_move() parses "row col" input; show_message() prints messages

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game loop that runs until win, draw, or quit
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py: while True loop that breaks on win, draw, or when get_move() returns None (quit)
